acceptanceCriteria: ticket search --fields accepts labels and effects.touchPaths, or the refusal names the supported route that returns them
multi-word --text behaviour is token-based or documented, with a test
body:
Observed 2026-10-21 with corvint-tasks build 695.
Reproduction: `ticket search --status OPEN --milestone v1-0 --fields ticketId,labels` exits ERROR with MALFORMED, saying labels is not in this read's items. effects is refused the same way.
Result: batch planning has to read the .taskman ticket projection files directly to get labels and touchPaths.
Also: multi-word `--text` phrases such as "pre-compact kill" return nothing while single words match. An earlier `--query` attempt was MALFORMED.
Expected: search can project labels and effects (or the documented field list says why not), and phrase matching is documented or token-based.

title: ticket search cannot project labels or effects, and --text matches poorly on multi-word phrases
